creator: Alexander Terp
description:
In the sidebar, when a helper has helpers of its own, the collapsed line for them ("1 helper · 1 done") sits directly under that helper, but its dot and text start left of the helper's dot. It reads as a sibling of the helper, or as part of the maker's group, rather than as the helper's child. Seen 2026-11-06 on a devenv tab whose maker had six helpers, three of them (satin, knot, dolphin) with helpers of their own: the three nested lines looked like rows of the outer "6 helpers" group. `muster window` draws the same tree correctly, each nested helper indented under its owner.

Likely cause: SidebarRowView.show (Sources/MusterMac/Sidebar.swift, `indent = (row.isPane || row.isHelpers ? 1 : 0) + row.depth`) gives a helpers line the same indent step as its maker's helpers (appendHelpers passes depth + 1), but a pane row also reserves the number column and dot before its name, and a helpers line does not, so the same indent lands further left. Want: a helpers line starts at or past its maker's name, at every depth.
title: A helper's own helpers line is drawn left of the helper it belongs to
